title: Potent Robe

sources.title: Well-Liked and Well-Fortified
markers: even if the new source is of a lesser value

summary: Clothing with +1 Armour Class, bonus cantrip damage, and recurring temporary HP.

fields.Gregarious Caster: Cantrips add your Charisma modifier to damage. Stacks with effects such as Agonising Blast, Draconic Elemental Affinity and Necklace of Elemental Augmentation on eligible cantrips.
fields.Well-Liked and Well-Fortified: At the start of each turn, gain temporary HP equal to Charisma modifier. Other temporary HP sources of equal or higher stack priority may overwrite these even when their value is lower.
fields.Acquisition: Alfira rewards Rescue the Tieflings at Last Light Inn, X −56, Y 141. She must survive. The Dark Urge can use a nonlethal knockout on Alfira before her scripted camp night to substitute Quil.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
